samples.question: Read panels 1 through 5 from left to right. Each row pairs a pip-labeled token (A has one black pip, B two, C three, and D four) with an arrow showing that token's direction in that panel. A token has returned only after its arrow first points away from its panel-1 direction and later points back to it. Which token returns to its panel-1 direction first? Answer A, B, C, or D.
